Package com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote

Purpose of this package is to host all response beans related to Quote data.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    CidData
    Purpose of this class is to hold the properties of the Correction Insertion Deletion Data.
    CidFieldData
    Purpose of this class is to hold the properties of the Correction Insertion Deletion Field Data.
    CidPriceFieldData
    Purpose of this class is to hold the properties of the Correction Insertion Deletion Price Field Data.
    Quote.FieldItem
    A Quote contains collection of Quote.FieldItem.
    QuoteRequest
    Purpose of this interface is to provide possible request options while making a request or subscription for Quote or Quote chain.
    QuoteRequestFilter<T>
    QuoteRequestFilter has been added in order to control the response specifically on the Chains.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    BundleQuoteRequest
    Purpose of this class is to make sure the request has a bundle on.
    DefaultQuoteRequest
    This is a default implementation to be used for the QuoteRequest.
    Quote
    Purpose of this class is to hold Quote information.
    Status
    This class is used to hold the enum's whose values should be used for ANDing them against the status bitmap array values.
  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    CATEGORY Deprecated
    FIELDFORMAT
    The FIELDFORMAT is a list of formats supported for Quote.FieldItem.
    LOOKUPTYPE
    The LOOKUPTYPE allows the user to do a keyLookup using one of these types.
    MSTATUS
    This class is used to return a bitmap of bits mostly relating to premarket, but a format bit flag is there as well.
    Quote.SYMBOLTYPE Deprecated
    Replaced by LOOKUPTYPE
    QUOTEFIELDS Deprecated
    QuoteRequest.CHAIN_TYPE
    Select the type of chain while making a quote request.
    QuoteRequest.DATASET_TYPE
    This enumeration holds the possible values for the Dataset type.
    QuoteRequestFilter.OPERATORS
    Purpose of this enum is to apply appropriate OPERATORS on Filters, to check the equality/inequality of the Filter values.
    Status.STATUS_BYTE_FIVE
    This enum is used with the index 4 of the status[] that is returned from the QuoteRequest in the QUOTEFIELDS.STATUS_QUOTE_FIELD The value of status[4] should be bitwise ANDed with the value of this enum to check if the bit is set.
    Status.STATUS_BYTE_FOUR
    This enum is used with the index 3 of the status[] that is returned from the QuoteRequest in the QUOTEFIELDS.STATUS_QUOTE_FIELD The value of status[3] should be bitwise ANDed with the value of this enum to check if the bit is set.
    Status.STATUS_BYTE_ONE
    This enum is used with the index 0 of the status[] that is returned from the QuoteRequest in the QUOTEFIELDS.STATUS_QUOTE_FIELD The value of status[0] should be bitwise ANDed with the value of this enum to check if the bit is set.
    Status.STATUS_BYTE_SIX
    This enum is used with the index 5 of the status[] that is returned from the QuoteRequest in the QUOTEFIELDS.STATUS_QUOTE_FIELD The value of status[5] should be bitwise ANDed with the value of this enum to check if the bit is set.
    Status.STATUS_BYTE_THREE
    This enum is used with the index 2 of the status[] that is returned from the QuoteRequest in the QUOTEFIELDS.STATUS_QUOTE_FIELD The value of status[2] should be bitwise ANDed with the value of this enum to check if the bit is set.
    Status.STATUS_BYTE_TWO
    This enum is used with the index 1 of the status[] that is returned from the QuoteRequest in the QUOTEFIELDS.STATUS_QUOTE_FIELD The value of status[1] should be bitwise ANDed with the value of this enum to check if the bit is set.
    SUBCATEGORY Deprecated
